instruction: Add the following reference to the References section: "Johnson, R. M., & Thompson, L. A. (2019). Digital marketing strategies in the modern era. Journal of Business Innovation, 45(3), 112-128. doi:10.1234/jbi.2019.45.3.112"

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.citation_text: Johnson, R. M., & Thompson, L. A. (2019). Digital marketing strategies in the modern era. Journal of Business Innovation, 45(3), 112-128. doi:10.1234/jbi.2019.45.3.112

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a journal article reference citation to the References section of the essay. The evaluator checks if the complete citation text appears in the References section specifically after the agent completes the task. The custom getter identifies and extracts only text from the References section (after 'References' heading), and the metric function checks if the expected citation text is present in that section.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies and extracts only the References section by finding 'References' heading and collecting subsequent text until next section
Metric correctly performs normalized substring comparison to check if citation appears in References section text
Expected value matches the citation text from the instruction
Postconfig includes file save (Ctrl+S) to ensure document is saved before verification
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts References section → metric checks citation presence → returns 1.0 if found
Minor edge case: evaluator assumes References section heading already exists in document - if user needs to create the section, getter will return empty string and fail verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fallback logic in getter to handle case where References section doesn't exist yet (e.g., search entire document if no References heading found, or return indicator that section is missing)
Add validation in metric to provide more informative score/feedback when References section is not found vs. citation not found in existing section
